name: openbb_market_news
description:
Latest general market and world news through the OpenBB Platform (obb.news.world).
Returns: {provider, articles_count, articles: [records with date, title, text, url]} or {error}.
Inputs (* required): limit (articles; default 10); provider (benzinga, fmp, intrinio, tiingo; default fmp).
News about one company: openbb_company_news, yf_news; keyword news search: tavily_news_search. Keys: fmp uses SAJHA's FMP_API_KEY; benzinga, intrinio, tiingo need a key in ~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json.
Example: {"limit": 10}
